description: This Java source file defines the class 'AgreementServices' which provides services related to accounting agreements, such as calculating commissions for products based on agreement terms. It includes imports, class definition, constants, and a method 'getCommissionForProduct' that computes commissions for a given product and invoice item, returning detailed commission data.

classes.name: AgreementServices
classes.description: Provides services related to agreement management, specifically calculating commissions based on agreement terms.

methods.name: getCommissionForProduct
methods.description: Calculates commission parties and amounts for a specific product, invoice item, and quantity based on agreement terms and returns a list of commission details.
